text: SF7 handoff: TrialwiseCall now admits onsets, subset, phase+parent, and explicit id-column; parser/printer/bound builder carry them. Builder validates explicit ids within each run, qualifies labels and phase parents by run, and preserves selected provenance. Added TrialwiseFormulaSuite with roundtrip, selected timing, phase provenance, unequal-run IDs, duplicate-ID failure, and modulator binding regression. FormulaPrinter exposes expressionText/expressionTextEither. Static check git diff --check clean; parent owns combined JVM/JS gate. LSS remains existing FitEngine.LeastSquaresSeparate only; no target-specific design constructor exists.
